subject: Post-call playbook: align on platform deep-dive & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@brightline.health>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call playbook: align on platform deep-dive & procurement next steps

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Brightline is prioritizing low-latency inference for near-real-time patient triage, needs SSO + SCIM for user provisioning, and wants predictable unit economics for a pilot (10k requests/day).

Proposed objectives for the next meeting (platform deep-dive):
- Walk through a short architecture map (SSO, network, data flow)
- Show a 25-minute sandbox demo focused on inference latency and cost controls
- Identify procurement path, required PO/contract owners, and any redlines

Can you confirm which stakeholders should join? It would be ideal to have: security (IT/Security), procurement (contracts/accounts payable), and a platform/ops engineer.

Suggested windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 11/24: 09:00–10:00 OR 14:00–15:00
- Wed 11/25: 11:00–12:00 OR 15:00–16:00

If none of those work, share two slots that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached a short post-call summary and a pre-demo access checklist so your ops team can validate access ahead of time.

Next steps for us: I’ll loop in Markus (platform engineer) and Monica (CS) once you confirm stakeholders and a preferred time.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference
Attachments: postcall-summary.pdf (1 page), pre-demo-access-checklist.md (text)

Subject: Re: Post-call playbook: align on platform deep-dive & procurement next steps

Marissa —

Great summary, thanks. I’ve looped in Jared (IT security lead) and Kate (procurement). A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Security would like a short SOC 2 / data handling summary before the demo (not the whole report, just scope + controls).
- Procurement needs a standard timeline for contracts (we typically take 2–3 weeks from redline to signature).

Availability constraints: Jared is only available Tue morning PT; Kate prefers afternoons but can make Tue AM if it’s the only practical time.

Tue 11/24 09:00 PT would work for us if Markus and your platform engineer can join. Please share a calendar invite and any short SSO docs ahead of time.

Thanks — Alyssa

Alyssa Turner

Agenda (30–45 min):

- 10 min security & compliance Q&A (Sean)
- 20 min platform demo: latency/cost controls and SSO flow (Markus)
- 5–10 min procurement / next steps (Marissa + Kate)

Attachments I’m sharing now: sso-integration-outline.pdf (SSO checklist + SCIM notes) and the one-page post-call summary. Monica will have the pilot cadence notes handy in case procurement asks about timelines/commitments.
